purpose: ring-neuron dopamine stage 1: EB reach census and paired dark/driven probe
limitation: The probe does not separate the dopamine field from CX_DAN's fast synapses. The fixture retains dan_fast_synapses; CX_DAN has 212 direct edges onto the 228 traced ER cells (381 synapses, all excitatory) against TuBu's 479 edges and 15,213 synapses. The composed-threshold shift is field-mediated by construction (it is exactly the d_v term); the spike and voltage changes are consistent with the field but this run does not attribute them to it. A dan_fast_synapses: disconnect arm would be needed to isolate the field.
reading_note: The dark arm's union responder count of 55 matches item 131's 55 of 228, but the responder sets differ by one single-seed marginal cell (item 131 fires engine index 12430; this run fires 102197) and the per-seed counts differ. The two runs draw different background noise realisations, so the match is a stable union count across realisations, not a bit-identical replay. No pass floor or threshold is applied; every interval is a paired driven-minus-dark mean over the ten seeds with mean +/- 1.96 SE, and the TuBu source-rate interval includes zero.

reachability.euler_note: 1 ms explicit Euler of the same pool balance used by Neuromod.on_chunk, 20 s from the 0.02 uM baseline

probe.purpose: ring-neuron dopamine stage 1: per-cell measurement of the ER response to injected TuBu input with the dopamine field dark versus driven; a null here is a real null

protocol.source_event_definition: sum over TuBu-to-target recurrent event amplitudes in the measurement window, after substrate weight scaling and live postsynaptic gain

paired.unit: paired difference is driven minus dark over the ten seeds; the interval is mean +/- 1.96 SE
